customMethods.name: load
customMethods.script:
cell = self.view.params.cellLocationId
	opts = BlueRidge.Parts.Item.getEligibleForLocationDropdown(cell) if cell else []
	itemId = self.view.params.itemId
	if not itemId and len(opts) == 1:
		itemId = opts[0]["value"]
	self.view.custom.partOptions = opts
	self.view.custom.itemId = itemId
	self.loadPart()

customMethods.name: loadPart
customMethods.script:
t = self.session.custom.terminal
	tid = t["terminalLocationId"] if t else None
	itemId = self.view.custom.itemId
	self.view.custom.activeField = ""
	packOuts = BlueRidge.Parts.ContainerConfig.listForItem(itemId, tid)
	draft = BlueRidge.Parts.PackOutPopup.draftForItem(itemId, packOuts)
	self.view.custom.packOuts = packOuts
	self.view.custom.loaded = system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(draft))
	self.view.custom.editDraft = draft
	self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1
	pn = ""
	if itemId:
		item = BlueRidge.Parts.Item.getOneOrEmpty(itemId) or {}
		pn = "%s" % (item["PartNumber"] or "")
	self.view.custom.partLabel = pn

customMethods.name: addMethod
customMethods.script:
# + New / Add: a blank named pack-out for this method in the form.
	draft = system.util.jsonDecode(BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.editDraft)) or {}
	block = BlueRidge.Parts.PackOutPopup.blankBlock(self.view.custom.itemId, method)
	block["Active"] = True
	draft[method] = block
	self.view.custom.editDraft = draft
	self.view.custom.activeField = method + ".PartsPerTray"

customMethods.name: pickPackOut
customMethods.script:
t = self.session.custom.terminal
	tid = t["terminalLocationId"] if t else None
	# A pack-out button: the running one just loads into the form; another one is
	# first selected for this terminal (SQL refuses while a box is open).
	rows = (BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.packOuts) or {}).get(method) or []
	row = ([r for r in rows if r.get("PackOutId") == packOutId] or [None])[0]
	if row is None:
		return
	if not row.get("IsRunning"):
		res = BlueRidge.Parts.ContainerConfig.select(tid, packOutId, BlueRidge.Common.Session.currentAppUserId(self.session)) or {}
		if not res.get("Status"):
			BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Pack-out not changed", res.get("Message") or "Unknown error", "warning")
			return
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Pack-out changed", res.get("Message") or "", "success")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("packOutChanged", payload={"itemId": self.view.custom.itemId}, scope="page")
	self.loadPart()
	draft = system.util.jsonDecode(BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.editDraft)) or {}
	draft[method] = BlueRidge.Parts.PackOutPopup.blockFromRow(self.view.custom.itemId, row)
	loaded = system.util.jsonDecode(BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.loaded)) or {}
	loaded[method] = dict(draft[method])
	self.view.custom.loaded = loaded
	self.view.custom.editDraft = draft

customMethods.name: makeDefault
customMethods.script:
pid = self.view.custom.editDraft[method]["PackOutId"]
	res = BlueRidge.Parts.ContainerConfig.setDefault(pid, BlueRidge.Common.Session.currentAppUserId(self.session)) or {}
	ok = bool(res.get("Status"))
	BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Default pack-out" if ok else "Default not changed", res.get("Message") or "", "success" if ok else "warning")
	if ok:
		system.perspective.sendMessage("packOutChanged", payload={"itemId": self.view.custom.itemId}, scope="page")
		self.loadPart()

customMethods.name: removePackOut
customMethods.script:
pid = self.view.custom.editDraft[method]["PackOutId"]
	res = BlueRidge.Parts.ContainerConfig.deprecate(pid, BlueRidge.Common.Session.currentAppUserId(self.session)) or {}
	ok = bool(res.get("Status"))
	BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Pack-out removed" if ok else "Pack-out not removed", res.get("Message") or "", "success" if ok else "warning")
	if ok:
		system.perspective.sendMessage("packOutChanged", payload={"itemId": self.view.custom.itemId}, scope="page")
		self.loadPart()

customMethods.name: save
customMethods.script:
if not self.view.custom.itemId:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("No part selected", "Pick the part this pack-out is for.", "warning")
		return
	nowMs = system.date.toMillis(system.date.now())
	if nowMs < (self.view.custom.busyUntil or 0):
		return
	self.view.custom.busyUntil = nowMs + 2000
	res = BlueRidge.Parts.PackOutPopup.saveDraft(self.view.custom.itemId, self.view.custom.editDraft, self.view.custom.loaded, BlueRidge.Common.Session.currentAppUserId(self.session))
	if res and res.get("Status"):
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Pack-out saved", self.view.custom.partLabel, "success")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("packOutChanged", payload={"itemId": self.view.custom.itemId}, scope="page")
		system.perspective.closePopup("mpp-packout-edit")
	else:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Pack-out not saved", (res or {}).get("Message") or "Unknown error", "error")
		self.view.custom.busyUntil = 0

messageHandlers.script:
if payload and payload.get("method") and payload.get("packOutId"):
		self.view.rootContainer.pickPackOut(payload.get("method"), payload.get("packOutId"))
